title: Super Mario Party Jamboree
subtitle: A larger gathering at the Party Plaza
summary: Super Mario Party Jamboree is Nintendo Cube's Switch party game, released on 17 October 2024.
body: Super Mario Party Jamboree is Nintendo Cube's Switch party game, released on 17 October 2024. A large collection of boards and activities gathers Mario's cast around the Party Plaza, combining the usual race for Stars with cooperative and competitive alternatives. The main board game keeps players moving independently through changing routes and events. Its broader selection makes choosing the activity part of hosting the gathering: the same group can settle into a board match or move towards something shorter and more directly physical.

Jamboree Buddies appear during board matches and trigger a minigame that decides who gains their help. A buddy lasts for several turns, can double a space's effect and provides an ability tied to the character. Winning that companion therefore changes the value of a later destination as well as the current contest. Pro Rules offer a more controlled competitive arrangement, while motion-controlled minigames can be excluded from ordinary board play. The options let a group adjust how much uncertainty or physical input belongs in its match.

Other activities turn the Joy-Con towards rhythmic cooking, cooperative machinery puzzles and imitated flight. Party Planner Trek gives a solo player missions across the boards, and online modes expand some competitions to larger groups. Shigenobu Okawa and Yuta Yamaguchi composed the music. The original Switch version establishes the collection, with an expanded Switch 2 edition following in 2025. Jamboree develops the party as a set of possible arrangements, keeping the recognizable board contest at its center while giving the same cast and controllers several other reasons to gather.
